caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal decorative metal railing, composed of dark, muted greenish-black bars and intricate scrollwork. The central part of the railing features intertwined, curving bands that loop to form ovals and spirals, interspersed with stylized leaf motifs and geometric shapes. Two leaf designs are prominently visible within the scroll pattern. There are two small, cylindrical feet supporting the structure at the bottom. The background is a plain, light beige color, and in the lower right corner, the name "Pearl Torell" is written in small, light-gray script. The overall composition centers the metal railing horizontally against the otherwise empty background.
title: Fence
